text:
maria: Heads-up: rolled HotStart warmup for short-prefix (chatty) workloads to prod in us-west1/us-east1/eu-west1. Early sampled numbers: p50 ~-18%, p99 ~-9%, est GPU cost/token ~-7%.

ben_s: awesome, congrats! where are the canary metrics?

maria: canary hw-canary-2026-03-23, dashboard link: https://dashboard.redwood-internal/boards/hotstart-warmup (infra access). We did 50% per region for ~2h then full flip. Example checks used: avg_over_time(inference_latency_p50{policy="hotstart"}[1h]) - baseline_p50; histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(token_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le)).

suyash: any GPU mem/IO spikes during warmup?

maria: transient +6% GPU mem on smallest model class; capped warmup concurrency to 8 jobs/node and set prefetch_window=300ms. No OOMs.

ajenkins: rollback triggers?

maria: auto-fail to cold path if >5m: p99 +12% vs baseline OR GPU mem >90% sustained 1m OR error rate +0.5%. Also one-click revert in Console (devops only).

irene: Dedicated pools affected?

maria: Dedicated default is OPT_OUT. Admins can opt-in via warmup_policy=OPT_IN. Enterprise customers can request rollout via support.

deploy-bot: canary/hw-canary-2026-03-23 complete: 50->100% flip @3532100068 :white_check_mark:

ben_s: please add a short blurb to runtime release notes with recommended defaults for short-prefix workloads.

maria: done. TL;DR: prefetch_window=300ms, max_warmup_concurrency=8, short_prefix_threshold=64 tokens. Monitoring will watch tails for 72h. Ping me if you see regressions.
